data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin to choose dates and years with rounded calendars and customizable themes.
data.what_it_does: Provides customizable date, year, and time pickers featuring rounded borders, custom themes, multiple language locales, and support for the Buddhist era.
use_when: You need date or time pickers with custom rounded styling and themes.
Your application requires localization and support for different eras like Buddhist years.
avoid_when: You need standard platform-native date picker widgets without extra visual customizations.
strengths: Extensive customization options for themes, text styles, and layout elements.
Supports around 52 languages and localization out-of-the-box.
Includes support for both Material and Cupertino style pickers.
weaknesses: License is unknown based on the provided metadata.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding flutter_localizations and localization delegates in MaterialApp.

alternatives.name: calendar_date_picker2
alternatives.why_pick_it: Alternative calendar and date picker package with custom UI features.

data.minimal_example:
DateTime newDateTime = await showRoundedDatePicker(
  context: context,
  initialDate: DateTime.now(),
  firstDate: DateTime(DateTime.now().year - 1),
  lastDate: DateTime(DateTime.now().year + 1),
  borderRadius: 16,
);
